Check the end at the end of your own turn or during a break when appeal and conservation are in the same scoring area or pass one another. Appeal gained during another player's turn waits for the end of your own turn or a break to trigger the end unless someone else triggers it first. A triggering player finishes their turn; then every other player gets one final turn. If triggered during a break, every player gets one final turn. Each Final Scoring card can give at most 4 conservation points. VP equals your Appeal value minus the lowest Appeal value in your Conservation counter's scoring area. Highest positive VP wins; ties go to the player with the most supported projects (tokens removed from the map), then tied players share the victory.
